description: Synthetic local interface fixture. No wallets, real CAW, signatures, blockchain settlement or private messages are used.
policies: All amounts use 18 decimal places solely for this local fixture; these are not verified token integration settings.
Historical appendix fees are displayed as a provisional scenario; prose and appendix distribution conflicts remain unresolved.
Fixed stake weights are 3, 1 and 2; they are separate from synthetic balances. Every pool excludes the payer.
Integer division rounds each eligible stake credit down. Unallocated base units remain visible in poolDust, with no builder recipient.
No eligible other staker rejects the action. Self-interactions and repeated likes, reCAWs and follows are rejected.
Messages use a provisional 420 Unicode code-point limit, preserving exact valid text without normalization.
Device labels simulate account-control checks; they are not credentials or cryptographic authentication.
Transfer only changes a synthetic controller, increments its ownership epoch and invalidates older pending intents.
Local export/rebuild checks internal consistency. It does not authenticate an original history or demonstrate permanent storage.

posts.author: pioneer
posts.text: Build in the open. Keep the receipts. This local room is a sketch of the journey, with synthetic balances only.

posts.text: A post can be inspected without pretending that its claim is true. Read the words. Check the record.

posts.author: keeper
posts.text: If one interface disappears, the records should still be useful. Local replay is a first check; permanent public storage is still unresolved.
